x: This famous training spot is not so well frequented as in Herb Elliott's day, though it still sees Herb and his sons on occasional week-ends.

There are some major advantages to the sport out here, which properly used, I believe will make Australia a strong international force, which has not been the case since Herb Elliott, Ron Clarke, Ralph Doubell, Alby Thomas and Betty Cuthbert dominated in the fifties and sixties.
